summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for CleanWard, a mobile-first civic sanitation reporting web app and PWA for Indian towns. Covers public reporting with EXIF-stripped canvas processing and 30m Haversine deduplication, public tracking with 3-decimal geo-fuzzing and 7-day citizen verification/reopen, Google-authenticated officer dashboard with strict state machine and before/after photo inspection, public ward scoreboard with 30-day resolution medians, admin ward/SLA management, and zero-trust Firestore security rules.
